statement.title: One works, from the sheet to the boxed part
statement.text: We cut, fold, weld, coat and assemble in the same halls, so a part never waits on a lorry between two firms.

steps.title: Fifty years on Fenner Lane
steps.text: How a two-man press shop became a works of four halls.

items.title: The first press
items.text: Arthur Pellworth buys a second-hand press and rents half a barn on Fenner Lane.

items.title: The first laser
items.text: The barn becomes Hall 1 and the first laser cutter replaces the punch.

items.title: The paint line
items.text: A powder-coating line in Hall 3 brings finishing in house.

items.title: Hall 4
items.text: Assembly and packing move into a new hall with its own loading bay.

items.d: The person who quotes your part follows it to the van.
